name: Dungeon
description: Adventure sites, ruins, lairs, and hostile complexes

fields.description: collapsed sacred chambers surrounding a sealed altar that still receives offerings.
natural tunnels expanded with barricades, storerooms, cells, and hidden exits.
broken walls above intact arsenals, command tunnels, and forgotten defenders.
family tombs, funerary traps, ancestral records, and disturbed sealed chambers.
stacked laboratories where failed experiments have altered gravity and space.
flooded halls accessible during low tide, through diving, or by ancient pumps.
interconnected nests shaped by generations of increasingly large inhabitants.
buried streets and homes connected through basements and sinkholes.
a noble residence repeating the final night before its household's destruction.
heat-blasted tunnels, sacrificial bridges, lava channels, and fireproof guardians.
ice-preserved halls where opening doors releases ancient air, disease, and occupants.
disguised meeting rooms descending into ritual chambers and an unfinished summoning site.
an enormous organism whose chambers digest intruders and rearrange like organs.
a mental complex entered through sleep, with exits hidden in prisoners' memories.
a structure descending into the earth while gravity points toward its distant roof.
an abandoned diplomatic complex built for visitors with incompatible bodies and physics.
precise mechanical rooms that reset traps and rotate corridors on a fixed schedule.
primeval tunnels inside a colossal root system infected by a spreading corruption.
a remote ruin whose lenses open physical paths toward dangerous celestial objects.
Unstable remains of an abandoned domain, still protected by traps, guardians, or oaths.
Galleries abandoned after an accident whose official cause contradicts the traces below.
A natural network adapted by a creature, a community, or fugitives.
Cells, archives, and service passages preserve evidence of a detention erased from history.
A network larger than the present city, linking cisterns, crypts, and forbidden foundations.
Open graves and displaced monuments surround a vault someone is trying to reach.
A recent depression where stone, magic, or time behaves differently.
An abandoned chapel or temple whose rites still produce effects without an officiant.
